subject.title: Group chat sessions not persisted — only 1 session from 166+ messages

question: Should the remaining fix be a narrow Telegram plain-group `updateLastRoute` repair, a broader shared non-direct delivery-context fallback, or deferred until live Telegram restart proof is captured?
rationale: Current source supports the reported plain-group gap, but the narrow Telegram fix and shared fallback have different channel compatibility, ownership, and proof requirements.

options.title: Prove and fix Telegram plain groups
options.body: Run live Telegram plain-group restart proof first, then repair Telegram plain-group route persistence without changing shared fallback behavior unless the proof points there.

options.title: Adopt a shared fallback
options.body: Use the shared non-direct delivery-context fallback as canonical, but require compatibility review across channel plugins before merge.

options.title: Wait for live proof
options.body: Keep the issue in maintainer review until a maintainer or reporter captures current-main restart evidence.

recommendation.title: Prove and fix Telegram plain groups
recommendation.body: Run live Telegram plain-group restart proof first, then repair Telegram plain-group route persistence without changing shared fallback behavior unless the proof points there.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision crosses the shared inbound session recorder and Telegram route-persistence boundary where this history is strongest.
